issues.title: Missing GWT/Verifies for individual artifacts
issues.why: The module delegates all per-script logic to 79 separate files (01-*.md to 79-*.md) which are not provided in this context. A coder cannot implement the actual tool logic (e.g., the cross-link checker or the tree-health script) without those specific ACs.
issues.fix: Provide the individual NN-*.md spec files or inline their core GWT logic into the overview.

issues.title: Unresolved External Memory/Constraint Refs
issues.why: The spec frequently references external symbols like 'mem://index.md', 'mem://constraints/forbidden-trace-map-ideas', and 'Phase 107 orphan ledger' which are not defined in the provided text.
issues.fix: Include the content of referenced memory files or define the specific constraints/ledger entries within the module.

issues.title: Ambiguous Exit Code 2 for Runners
issues.why: While validators have a clear 0,1,2 contract, the Runners (slots 40-49) are told to exit 130 on SIGINT (R4) but also follow the general exit-code contract which usually maps 2 to environmental errors.
issues.fix: Explicitly state that for Runners, exit 130 is the canonical SIGINT response and 2 is for environmental setup failure.
